description: This file defines the ProjectAPI class, a RESTful API endpoint for managing projects within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting project entities, along with associated validation rules and OpenAPI annotations for documentation. The class interacts with various services and models to handle project data and enforces access controls.

classes.name: ProjectAPI
classes.description: RESTful API endpoint for managing projects, implementing CRUD operations with request validation, data handling, and OpenAPI documentation annotations.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Determines the class of the project model (default or detailed) based on query parameters.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of projects based on filter parameters, access control, and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the parameters used in the getAll() method.

methods.name: getModelParamRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for the 'model' query parameter.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new project with data provided in the request body, after validating and verifying associated customer existence.

methods.name: setProject
methods.description: Populates a Project entity with data from request parameters, including customer ID, name, description, and project administrators.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the project creation request.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Provides common validation rules for project-related request bodies, including uniqueness, length, and existence checks.

methods.name: getProjectCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Creates an EntityUniquePropertyOption object used for validating project name uniqueness within a customer context.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes projects specified by IDs, ensuring they have no timesheet entries; throws exception if deletion is not permitted.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for the delete operation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific project by ID, verifying access permissions.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation rules for retrieving a single project.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing project with provided data, after validation and existence checks.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a project.
